# Renuka Tours & Travels

> Premium chauffeur-driven car, SUV, tempo traveller and coach rentals based in Bengaluru, serving local city travel, outstation trips, airport transfers, weddings, corporate travel and pilgrimage tours across South India.

Website: https://www.renukatoursandtravel.com

Renuka Tours & Travels has operated since 2011, running a fleet of sedans, SUVs, tempo travellers, luxury vans and mini coaches — all chauffeur-driven by verified, background-checked drivers — with transparent, upfront per-kilometre or per-package pricing and no surge pricing or hidden fees. Available 24×7. Renuka Tours & Travels does not offer self-drive/unchauffeured rentals — every vehicle comes with a driver.

## Key pages

- [Fleet](/fleet): Full vehicle lineup — sedans, SUVs, tempo travellers, a luxury van and mini coaches/buses — with seating capacity, luggage space, AC/fuel type and starting price per km for each vehicle.
- [Services](/services): Airport transfers, outstation trips, corporate travel, wedding transport, group & pilgrimage tours, and hourly local rentals.
- [Destinations](/destinations): 22 popular weekend and multi-day routes from Bengaluru with estimated cost and recommended vehicle for each.
- [Blog](/blog): Travel guides and planning tips — best time to visit, road-trip routes, pilgrimage logistics.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from the fleet and from past trips and destinations across South India.
- [Booking](/booking): Request a booking online — pre-fills a WhatsApp message to the operations team.
- [About](/about): Company history, fleet growth timeline, and safety/verification standards (driver checks, licensing, insurance, sanitisation).
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and office address.

## Facts

- Founded: 2011
- Fleet categories: sedans (4-seater), SUVs (6–7 seater), tempo travellers (9–17 seater), a luxury van (17 seater) and mini coaches/buses (21–50 seater)
- Coverage: every locality within Bengaluru (Whitefield, Electronic City, Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Marathahalli, Sarjapur Road, JP Nagar, Hebbal, Yelahanka, CV Raman Nagar, Kempegowda International Airport), nearby towns (Hosur, Tumkur, Ramanagara, Kolar, Nelamangala, Channapatna), and outstation trips across South India
- Pricing model: per-kilometre for outstation trips (from ₹13/km for a sedan), flat packages for local/hourly rentals, custom quotes for corporate/wedding/group bookings and for vehicles marked "price on request"
- Driver: every vehicle is chauffeur-driven by default — self-drive/unchauffeured rentals are not offered
- Insurance & verification: every vehicle carries valid insurance covering passengers and third parties; every driver is background-checked, licence-validated and interviewed before joining the fleet
- Address: 97/3, First Floor, Veerappa Compound, 14 E Acres, Nagavarapalya, CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560093, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95133 30099
- Email: renukatourstravels01@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24×7

## Frequently asked questions

**How is pricing calculated for outstation trips?**
Outstation trips are billed per kilometre, starting from ₹13/km for a sedan. Tolls, driver allowance and any interstate permit charges are shown upfront before you confirm — there's no surge pricing, ever.

**Do your vehicles come with a driver?**
Yes, every vehicle in the fleet is chauffeur-driven by a verified, background-checked driver — Renuka Tours & Travels does not offer self-drive/unchauffeured rentals.

**What types of vehicles do you have?**
The fleet spans five categories: sedans (4-seater), SUVs (6–7 seater), tempo travellers (9–17 seater), a luxury van (17 seater) and mini coaches/buses (21–50 seater) — so there's a fit whether it's a solo airport run or a 50-person pilgrimage group.

**How do I book a ride?**
Use the search bar on the homepage or the booking form at /booking to share your pickup, destination, date and passenger count. The team confirms the vehicle, price and pickup time by phone or WhatsApp, usually within the hour.

**Which cities and routes do you cover?**
Based in Bengaluru, covering every locality within the city plus outstation trips across South India, including Mysuru, Coorg, Ooty, Coonoor, Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Hampi, Tirupati, Dharmasthala, Mantralaya, Rameshwaram, Goa, Gokarna, Pondicherry, Kanyakumari, Trivandrum, Wayanad, Alleppey, Kumarakom, Kodaikanal, Munnar and Nandi Hills.

**Which areas within Bengaluru do you pick up from?**
All of Bengaluru — Whitefield, Electronic City, Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Marathahalli, Sarjapur Road, JP Nagar, Hebbal, Yelahanka, CV Raman Nagar and Kempegowda International Airport included.

**Do you serve towns near Bengaluru like Hosur, Tumkur or Ramanagara?**
Yes — beyond city limits, coverage regularly extends to nearby towns including Hosur, Tumkur, Ramanagara, Kolar, Nelamangala and Channapatna, in addition to every outstation route across South India.

**Is airport pickup tracked against my flight?**
Yes. Airport transfers include live flight tracking and free waiting time if your flight is delayed, so a late landing never means a missed ride.

**Are your vehicles insured and drivers verified?**
Every vehicle carries valid insurance covering passengers and third parties, and every driver goes through background checks, licence validation and an in-person interview before joining the fleet.

**Can I book for a corporate account or a wedding?**
Yes — corporate travel is available with monthly billing and a dedicated account manager, and wedding transport includes fleet decoration on request plus multi-vehicle coordination for multi-day functions.
